### Notes & Web

- Search note titles, paths and full text from one field. Resize or pin the sidebar, or open it temporarily without shifting the article.
- Resume from the reading home or the new Recents tab. Back and forward navigation restores reading positions.
- Preview linked notes before opening them, and browse the outline and backlinks in a shared information panel. Markdown properties, collapsible callouts and code copying make longer notes easier to read.
- Render mathematical formulas and Mermaid diagrams locally. Diagrams include source view, copying and an enlarged view; rendering failures preserve readable source.

### Model switching and CLI agents

- Keep reasoning controls on the main model view and switch CLI agents from the catalog. Model pins and saved presets are separated and scoped to the selected CLI.
- Preserve handoff drafts when switching agents, and recover from interrupted handoffs without mixing CLI workspaces.
- Make selected models and presets easier to distinguish, improve advanced model-picker recognition, and keep operation feedback tied to the relevant CLI.
- Older presets without a recorded CLI remain in your settings but are hidden from CLI-specific lists. Save them again under the intended CLI to show them there.

### Conversation and reliability

- Place each reply's outline button alongside its existing actions, and recognize updated Codex chat containers.
- Reduce repeated host scans and refresh work, and correct the background CPU reading.
- Preserve Palboo's CodexHost compatibility fixes when preparing managed controllers. Reader changes in development mode now rebuild the web assets before the backend switches to them.

### 阅读与网页

- 标题、路径和全文共用一个搜索框。侧栏可调宽、固定，也可临时展开而不推挤正文。
- 从阅读首页或新增的「最近」标签继续阅读；前进、后退时恢复阅读位置。
- 打开双链前可预览笔记，目录与反向链接集中在同一信息栏。支持 Markdown 属性、可折叠 Callout 和代码复制，方便阅读长笔记。
- 在本机渲染数学公式和 Mermaid 图表。图表可查看、复制源码及放大查看；渲染失败时保留可读源码。

### 模型切换与 CLI

- 推理档位保留在模型首页，CLI 切换集中在目录中。固定模型与完整预设分开，并按当前 CLI 隔离。
- 切换 Agent 时保留接力草稿，中断后可恢复接力，避免混用不同 CLI 的工作区。
- 加强模型与预设的选中状态，改进高级模型菜单识别，操作反馈跟随对应 CLI。
- 旧版未记录 CLI 来源的预设仍保留在配置中，但不显示在各 CLI 列表里；可在目标 CLI 下重新保存。

### 对话与稳定性

- 每条回复的大纲按钮并入原有操作栏，适配新版 Codex 聊天容器。
- 减少重复扫描与刷新，修正后台 CPU 读数。
- 准备受管理的 CodexHost 控制器时保留 Palboo 的兼容修复。开发模式修改阅读器后，先更新网页资源再交接后台。
